name: Engagemii
summary: Company records with AI visibility scores, AI engine reads, category, location, tech stack and social profiles from the Engagemii index.

api_key.description: an Engagemii data API key (starts with edk_) from the API access page of a free data account (https://engagemii.com/portal/data/api)

notes: Unit-based: every company record returned costs 1 unit; units are bought 5,000 for $250 (5 cents a unit) and never expire; /info and /orders are free, and nothing is charged on an error. Free lookups are used first: a data account gets 20, one time; an agency account gets 1 as a sample, then 2 a month while the Agency plan is paid; a brand account gets none.
60 requests a minute per key across all endpoints. Every answer carries X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset; past the limit the answer is 429 rate_limited with Retry-After.

A record has the same columns as an Engagemii data file: the 0 to 10 AI visibility score with its on-page and off-page parts, AI engine reads, AI naming, the agent readiness and AI adoption indexes, category, location, tech stack and social profiles. Column meanings: https://engagemii.com/aeo/data/dictionary.

endpoints.name: Get account units and limits
notes: Costs nothing; call it to check units left before a large pull.

endpoints.name: Look up a company by website
endpoints.summary: 1 unit when a record is returned, 0 otherwise.

domain.description: The company's website. Scheme, www and path are ignored.

notes: Starts a billed job when the website is not in the index yet: a paid lookup scans and scores it. If the scan finishes within about 20 seconds the record comes back in the same call; otherwise the answer is 202 scanning or queued with retryAfterSec, and the next call returns the record. A free lookup on such a website answers 404 not_found with reason not_indexed and starts nothing.

Returns record (the full data-file columns), company (standard field names such as name, website, industry, companyType, country, city, phone, linkedin) and sources (where each value came from). A field not held is left out.

A 202 filling answer means the record check is still running; call again after retryAfter seconds. completion.pending true means some cells finish in the background and a later call reads them. Every 202 costs nothing.
Scans of websites not yet in the index are limited to 30 an hour and 100 a day per key (429 scan_limit_key); websites already in the index still answer.
A second lookup of the same website within 24 hours of a charged one is free (allowance reread, unitsSpent 0).

endpoints.name: Search company records by filter
endpoints.summary: 1 unit per record returned; up to 5,000 records a call.

filters.description: Any of: industries (Technology, E-commerce, Food & Beverage, Health & Wellness, Healthcare, Beauty & Personal Care, Fashion & Apparel, Finance & Insurance, Legal, Real Estate, Travel & Hospitality, Education, Media & Entertainment, Home & Living, Pet Care, Automotive, Sports & Recreation, Professional Services, Nonprofits, Government & Public Sector, Membership Organizations, Manufacturing & Industrial, Other), states (US state names or codes), countries (names or 2-letter ISO codes), scope ('us', the default, or 'all' for worldwide), audienceTypes (B2B, B2C, Mixed, Other), scoreMin and scoreMax (AI visibility score, 0 to 10, inclusive), hasSocials, hasEmails, platforms, paymentProcessors, analytics, emailMarketing, reviews (lower-case names such as shopify, stripe, klaviyo, trustpilot) and publicCompanies ('only').

limit.description: Records per call, 1 to 5,000. Required here because the API's default is 1,000 records: 1,000 units ($50) at the standard rate, 10,000 units ($500) with filters.publicCompanies 'only'.

offset.description: 0 for the first page, then the nextOffset of the previous answer.

acceptUnitsPerRow.description: Confirms the 10-unit rate; required when filters.publicCompanies is 'only'.

notes: A read over POST: it only queries records.
Metered: 1 unit per record returned. filters.publicCompanies 'only' (US public companies, SEC ticker and CIK on every row) costs 10 units a record and runs only with acceptUnitsPerRow 10.
filters.scope defaults to 'us' (United States); send 'all' for worldwide.
Results come best AI visibility score first. Paging: send offset 0, then the nextOffset of each answer until hasMore is false; never add the count to offset.

A page with no record ready yet carries Retry-After (3, 5, then 8 seconds) and says how many records are still being completed. A filter or value that does not exist is refused with 400 before anything is read.

endpoints.name: List the account's data files
notes: The account's data orders, each ready file with a freshly signed download link. Costs nothing.
